en.name: Canadian bacon, sliced
en.summary: Sliced Canadian bacon keeps 10 days refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 80 days from purchase in an unopened vacuum pack, and 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: This is a cured but fully cooked, moist, ready-to-eat meat, and it does not belong at room temperature. It goes from the chiller cabinet to your fridge and stays there. Out of the fridge it gets two hours at most, and one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F); a breakfast platter standing on a warm table is exactly the wrong way to serve it. Because it is eaten without further cooking, there is no step left that would deal with contamination picked up along the way.
en.fridge: An unopened vacuum pack keeps 80 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; once opened, or for slices cut at a deli counter, the figure is 10 days. Keep it in the coldest part of the fridge, not the door, wrapped airtight so the surface does not dry and grey. This is a ready-to-eat meat, so Listeria is the organism that matters — it grows slowly even at refrigeration temperature, which is why the opened figure is so much shorter. People who are pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised are usually advised to heat ready-to-eat deli meats until steaming hot before eating them.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Slices freeze well if you separate them with baking paper and press the air out of the bag, which lets you take two rashers at a time instead of prising apart a frozen slab. The quality loss you will notice is a slightly watery, softer texture and a saltier edge; the meat stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C, and the figure is about how good it will taste. Freeze it well before the fridge date runs out, not on the last day.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight, or cook slices straight from frozen. You can also thaw in cold water in a sealed bag, changing the water every half hour. Never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the slices.
A sour, sulphurous or ammonia-like smell on opening the pack.
Grey, green or iridescent patches, or dull brown edges.
A puffed or leaking vacuum pack.
tips: Interleave slices with baking paper before freezing so you can take a few at a time.
Keep it on a cold shelf, never in the fridge door.
Write the opening date on the pack; the opened window is much shorter than the unopened one.
Heat it until steaming if you are pregnant or immunocompromised.

faq.q: How long does sliced Canadian bacon keep?
faq.a: 10 days refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 80 days from purchase in an unopened vacuum pack. Frozen, 12 months at −18 °C.
Yes, 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Separate the slices with paper so you can take out only what you need.

faq.q: Is it safe to eat straight from the pack?
faq.a: It is fully cooked, so yes for most people. Pregnant, elderly and immunocompromised people are advised to heat ready-to-eat deli meats until steaming hot first.

zh.name: 加拿大培根切片
zh.summary: 加拿大培根切片冷藏 4 °C 以下可放 10 天；未開封的真空包則是自購買日起 80 天。冷凍 −18 °C 下為 12 個月。
zh.pantry: 這是醃製但已完全煮熟、含水的即食肉品，不屬於室溫。它應該從冷藏櫃直接進你家冰箱，然後一直待在那裡。離開冰箱最多兩小時，廚房超過 32 °C 時最多一小時；把早餐拼盤放在溫暖的桌上慢慢吃，正是最不該做的事。因為它不需要再加熱就會被吃掉，所以中途沾染到的污染，後面已經沒有任何步驟可以處理。
zh.fridge: 未開封的真空包放 4 °C 以下，自購買日起 80 天；開封後、或是在熟食櫃現切的片，則是 10 天。請放冰箱最冷的位置而不是門邊，並密封包好，避免表面乾掉發灰。這是即食肉品，所以真正要提防的是李斯特菌——它在冷藏溫度下仍會緩慢生長，這正是開封後的數字短這麼多的原因。懷孕、年長或免疫功能低下的人，通常會被建議把即食熟肉加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月。切片之間夾烘焙紙、把袋子裡的空氣壓出來再冷凍，效果很好，之後要用兩片就拿兩片，不必去撬一整塊凍在一起的肉。你會察覺到的品質損失是質地略為出水變軟、鹹味更明顯；在 −18 °C 下它在安全上可以無限期保存，那個數字談的是好不好吃。請在冷藏期限用完之前就冷凍，不要拖到最後一天。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接從冷凍下鍋煎。也可以連密封袋泡冷水解凍，每半小時換一次水。不要放在室溫退冰。
spoilage: 切片表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜。
開封時聞到酸味、硫味或氨味。
出現灰色、綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或邊緣暗褐。
tips: 冷凍前在切片間夾烘焙紙，之後可以只取需要的量。
放冷藏層架，絕對不要放門邊。
在包裝上寫開封日期，開封後的期限比未開封短得多。
懷孕或免疫功能低下者，請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。

faq.q: 加拿大培根切片可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏 4 °C 以下 10 天；未開封真空包自購買日起 80 天。冷凍 −18 °C 下 12 個月。

faq.q: 加拿大培根可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 12 個月。切片之間夾紙，之後要多少拿多少。

faq.q: 可以直接從包裝拿出來吃嗎？
faq.a: 它已經完全煮熟，多數人可以。但懷孕、年長與免疫功能低下者，建議先加熱到冒蒸氣。
